history: Found as a CRASH. lex() built the value with int(text, base) the moment it saw the digits, and past 4300 decimal digits CPython refuses the conversion itself, so a raw ValueError escaped with no position and no diagnosis. docs/RL.md said 'All literals fit int64 or fail to compile'; this one failed differently. The receipt parser had met the identical CPython limit and closed it deliberately with MAX_INT_DIGITS.
note: 4301 digits, one past the limit, refused in the lexer with a position and a count. 4300 digits reaches the typer and is refused there for not fitting in int64 -- a different message for a different reason, which is correct.
